brief:
You build ONE ENGAGEMENT SYSTEM plugin for Lumen. Contract: SystemModule in src/core/systems.ts (id, player-facing name, internal `drive`, color, install(services) → uninstall). Read docs/ENGAGEMENT_DESIGN.md (internal psychology lens) and docs/research/04-sins-engagement.md for mechanics + ethical guardrails, and docs/GAME_DESIGN.md §7 for your system's player-facing name and scope.
How systems plug in (never import other systems/scenes — boundaries are enforced):
- Persist state with services.save.slot('sys:<id>', initial, { version }).
- Listen to bus events (src/core/events.ts): case:started, history:asked, test:completed, diagnosis:submitted, case:completed (has the full ScoreBreakdown), case:failed, mode:started/ended, practice:completed, currency:grant/currency:changed, xp:grant/rank:changed, patient:arriving, app:ready, scene:changed.
- Announce rewards with bus.emit('reward:granted', {source:'<id>', label, value, icon, color, rarity}) — the results screen shows them; use toast / achievement:unlocked events for moments; juice with services.fx and services.audio.
- Contribute UI by registering in install(): HudWidgets (services.registries.hud.register({ id, slot, order, system:'<id>', component })) for slots topbar-left | topbar-right | hub-banner | hub-sidebar | exam-overlay | results-extra | profile; a HubEntry tile (services.registries.hub.register(...)) and, if your system has a page, a SceneModule (services.registries.scenes.register(...)) with a full-screen scene using @ui-kit Screen/Backdrop. Components are Preact; read state with useSignal from @ui-kit.
- install() must be idempotent-safe and the returned uninstall must unsubscribe everything. The game must remain fully playable if your folder is deleted.
- Rewards must scale with LEARNING quality (correctness, efficiency, mastery), never with mere time spent; follow the ethical guardrails (no real money, no punitive loss, streak repair, natural stopping points).
- Polish: this is where players fall in love — make every widget and scene gorgeous (glass, glow, motion, count-ups, particles, sound), responsive (375px), accessible.
- PLAYER-FACING TEXT NEVER CONTAINS SIN WORDS. Use the clinic-themed names.
- Test logic with vitest using createServices() from @core (no DOM needed for most logic). Preview: create a sandbox page src/app/sandbox/pages/sys-<id>.tsx (default export { id, title, component }) that installs your system into props.services (`yourSystem.install(props.services)` via the folder's default export — the sandbox page is in src/app so it may import your folder) and fires synthetic events (e.g. fake case:completed with a ScoreBreakdown) with buttons, rendering your HUD widgets and scene — so reviewers can screenshot it at ?sandbox=page/sys-<id>. Scenes from other teams may still be under construction.

=== YOUR SYSTEM: id 'ranks', player-facing name 'Career', internal drive 'pride' (never shown) — folder src/systems/ranks/ ===
XP & rank ladder (Student → Intern → Resident → Associate → Senior → Clinic Director → Living Legend, with sub-levels and a smooth XP curve), XP from case:completed (scaled by score/grade, bonus for perfect & first-time diagnoses), xp:grant events from others; emit rank:changed with a spectacular rank-up moment (fx burst + 'levelup' + toast + achievement). Mastery stars (0-3) per diagnosis from services.learning.mastery() and grades. A trophy wall of 30+ achievements (first diagnosis, first S grade, 5 perfect cases, every test used, all emergencies triaged, 'Eagle eye' spot every fundus lesion, categories mastered, etc. — clinically themed names), achievement:unlocked events. HUD: topbar-left rank badge + XP ring; profile slot section; results-extra panel with XP gained animation and next-rank progress. Scene 'career': gorgeous career page (rank crest, XP bar, mastery constellation map of all diagnoses by category — stars light up as mastered, trophy wall with locked silhouettes). HubEntry to 'career'.

=== YOUR SYSTEM: id 'economy', player-facing name 'Boutique & coins', internal drive 'greed' (never shown) — folder src/systems/economy/ ===
Coins (✦ 'lumens'): pay per case:completed scaled by grade/total, combo-friendly; handle currency:grant from others; emit currency:changed. Surprise SUPPLY CRATES (variable-ratio rewards): earn a crate on S grades / streak milestones / rank-ups; opening is a theatrical animation (crate shakes, light leaks, burst) revealing coins, hint tokens, or cosmetic items with rarity tiers (common/rare/epic/legendary) — deterministic RNG via services.rng.fork. Boutique scene 'boutique': a luxurious shop (velvet, brass, glass cases) selling cosmetics only for coins: clinic colour themes (apply by setting a data-theme attribute / CSS variables on document.documentElement — ship 4-6 themes that recolour accents tastefully), player eyewear frames for the profile, nameplate styles; owned/equipped states. No real money anywhere. HUD: topbar-left coin counter with count-up and coin-burst on gain; results-extra coins earned + crate reveal. HubEntry to 'boutique' with badge when crates are unopened.

=== YOUR SYSTEM: id 'rivals', player-facing name 'Rivals', internal drive 'envy' (never shown) — folder src/systems/rivals/ ===
3-5 AI colleagues with distinct personalities and procedurally generated avatars (use @render generateAvatar/AvatarBust with fixed seeds) — e.g. Dr. Vex (brilliant, smug), Dr. Amara Okafor (meticulous), Dr. Kenji Mori (fast), Dr. Lucía Reyes (kind mentor) — each with a deterministic simulated performance per case (score, time, grade, sometimes making a classic mistake that teaches something: 'skipped tonometry, missed the angle closure'). Weekly league board (resets weekly by dayKey/week number) mixing rival points that grow over the week with the player's points from case:completed; overtake moments ('You passed Dr. Vex!' toast + fx) and being overtaken nudges (gentle). HUD: topbar-right mini standing (#2 ↑); results-extra 'How your colleagues did on this patient' comparison with their quips; hub-sidebar card. Scene 'rivals': a gorgeous league table with portraits, sparkline of the week, rival profile cards and their 'signature' strengths. HubEntry to 'rivals'. Keep it motivating, never humiliating.

=== YOUR SYSTEM: id 'streaks', player-facing name 'Streaks', internal drive 'gluttony' (never shown) — folder src/systems/streaks/ ===
In-run COMBO: consecutive correct diagnoses build a combo (x1 → x1.5 → x2 → x3) with escalating fire visuals and sound; announce on case:completed; reset on wrong (with a 'combo saved' grace once per run if grade ≥ B? design sensibly). DAILY STREAK: playing ≥ 1 case per day keeps a flame alive; streak freezes earned by play (auto-used once), milestone rewards (3/7/14/30 days) via currency:grant + reward:granted; never guilt-trip. Near-miss nudges on results ('120 points from your best Rush Hour', 'one more for a x3 combo'). Personal bests per mode. HUD: topbar-right flame with day count; exam-overlay combo meter (subtle, top corner) during runs; results-extra 'Next patient' momentum panel (combo status + one-more nudge; it should not navigate itself — just display). Hub-sidebar card with streak calendar. No scene required (optional small 'streaks' modal is fine).

=== YOUR SYSTEM: id 'collection', player-facing name 'Gallery', internal drive 'lust' (never shown) — folder src/systems/collection/ ===
Every completed case (correct diagnosis) grants an IRIS CARD: a collectible, procedurally painted iris artwork (use @render paintIrisArt with a seed derived from the case and the patient's irisColor) with rarity by grade (S → epic/legendary chance), holographic foil shimmer that follows the pointer/tilt, the patient's name, diagnosis name (look it up via services.registries.diagnoses), date, and a teaching pearl on the back (flip animation) — cards double as flash-cards. Collection progress per diagnosis category, set completion rewards (xp:grant, currency:grant), duplicates upgrade a card's frame (bronze → silver → gold → prismatic). Scene 'gallery': a museum-like gallery with soft spotlights, filter by category/rarity, card inspect modal (3D tilt, flip). HUD: results-extra 'New card!' reveal with a dramatic pack-opening moment; hub-sidebar 'latest acquisition' card. HubEntry 'gallery' with NEW badge.

=== YOUR SYSTEM: id 'emergencies', player-facing name 'Code Red', internal drive 'wrath' (never shown) — folder src/systems/emergencies/ ===
Owns the adrenaline layer for emergency cases (case:started with emergency=true / timeLimitSec): exam-overlay widget with a dramatic countdown (Space Grotesk digits, ring that drains, colour shifts to crimson, pulse on last 10s), heartbeat audio that speeds up (services.audio 'heartbeat' at increasing rate; stop on end), red vignette pulses (services.fx.vignette), flashing 'CODE RED' banner on arrival with a short klaxon. It only DISPLAYS time; the exam scene enforces timeout (via services.session.state timeLimitSec + startedAt). On case:completed for an emergency with correct diagnosis + urgency: 'SIGHT SAVED' cinematic finale (hitstop, flash, sparks, big reward), bonus via currency:grant/xp:grant and reward:granted; wrong triage of an emergency → sober teaching toast about the red flags (no gore). Weekly 'Grand Rounds' challenge card (hub-banner) highlighting one emergency case (deterministic per week) with a bonus. Track emergency stats (saved, avg time) for a profile section. No own scene required (code-red mode already exists).

=== YOUR SYSTEM: id 'comfort', player-facing name 'Lounge', internal drive 'sloth' (never shown) — folder src/systems/comfort/ ===
Low-friction comfort & return rewards. DAILY GIFT: once per day a gift box in the lounge/hub-banner (tap to open → coins/crate via events) with a 7-day escalating calendar. CLINIC EARNINGS WHILE AWAY: the clinic accrues coins slowly while the player is away (capped at e.g. 8h), shown on return as a cosy 'Welcome back, Doctor' modal with a collect button (currency:grant) — computed from save timestamps + services.clock. COMEBACK BONUS after ≥ 3 days away (warm, no guilt). ONE-TAP RESUME: a hub-banner 'Continue' that starts the most suitable mode (call beginRun(services, modeId) from @core — prefer 'daily' if not done today, else 'shift'). Scene 'lounge': a cosy, beautiful clinic lounge (rain on the window, warm lamp, plants, a coffee steaming) showing the gift calendar, idle earnings jar, tips of the day (rotating clinical pearls pulled from services.registries.diagnoses), and a 'quiet mode' toggle that switches music to 'zen'. HubEntry 'lounge'. HUD: hub-banner gift/continue banner.
